_header.title: CHROME EXTENSION PACKAGE SETTINGS
version_1_1_changes: Added this _header block. JSON can't hold comments, so the header is a key
version_1_0_changes: New. Marks the folder as ES modules and gives the test and type-check commands.
description: Settings for the extension folder. There are no npm packages: Node 22.18 or
newer runs the .ts files directly, so no npm install is needed.
cli_usage: node --test       (or npm test)       run every test
npm run check                          optional type check (downloads TypeScript 7 once)
On Windows PowerShell, use npm.cmd / npx.cmd if scripts are blocked.
notes: The top-level "version" below is the extension's version, not this file's.
Keep it in step with manifest.json once that file exists.

name: beat-the-box-extension
description: Beat the Box for Chrome. Rules engine, strategy and simulator so far; the pages come next.
